WHAT THE IN-PROCESS SWAPS CANNOT SHOW: they substitute the STORAGE boundary for recorded artifacts, so they cannot show that the real S3 read is firm-scoped in the deployed role's IAM; they construct the header set directly, so they cannot show that the EDGE VALIDATOR injects those headers or that a caller cannot forge them; and they call the entry object in-process, so they cannot show CloudFront -> edge -> authorizer -> handler end to end. IB-rtb-1's real-path replay is the only arm that covers those three, and arm (g)'s success half waits on the same principal it does. SECOND VINTAGE, AFTER THE DEPLOY AND AMENDMENTS 3 AND 4. A guard that cannot import is not a guard, and three matching hashes say nothing about either. (4) Two authorized requests landed in the residual reason, which the estate's own enum calls a MEMBER and not an escape hatch. THE REST HELD: 3 of 3 control victims moved the census verdict; 5 of 5 difference controls; the version refusal holds with the storage loaders replaced by functions that raise; the revoked grant does not read as unprojected; and the byte census caught its own first definition, which listed the CALLER'S OWN firm id as protected and so failed on every correct answer.
mutant.description: One control per claim that could pass while being false. THE CENSUS: its population is derived from three artifacts nobody writes for it, and a throwaway copy with one handler unregistered must read 1 of N for three different victims. THE MARK: served.py runs the real guard decorator at import and refuses to load unmarked, so the census cannot be satisfied by a module setting an attribute. THE SWAPS: a DIFFERENCE control -- the same recorded artifacts must SERVE the authorized request, or the thirty negatives prove nothing. THE VERSION CHECK: exercised with the storage loaders REPLACED BY FUNCTIONS THAT RAISE, so 'checked first' is proven rather than asserted. THE PROJECTION: paired with a REVOKED grant, because UNPROJECTED and EMPTY are indistinguishable in the result. THE BYTE CENSUS: relative to who is asking, so it cannot pass by protecting nothing or fail by protecting the caller's own id. THE ADVISOR SWAP: asserted on WIDENING rather than on refusal, because a list operation answering a different advisor is correct behaviour.
